purpose: Historical Stripe coupon and make-good surface. Retired by the one-time paid Store app pivot: AI-unavailable now shows local support guidance, refunds are directed to Microsoft Store/support options, and no backend coupon is minted from the installed app.

capabilities.name: next_repair_coupon
capabilities.function: A reusable 50%-off Stripe coupon (COUPON_ID=NEXTREPAIR50) + a unique single-use promotion code minted per completed run; presented at completion.

capabilities.name: make_good_coupon
capabilities.function: A single-use 100%-off promotion code tagged with email+machine metadata, minted via /api/report-ai-unavailable when on-device AND cloud authors both decline; emailed to the customer + a Support incident raised.

capabilities.name: honest_recourse
capabilities.function: RETIRED backend coupon path. Current honest recourse is local support guidance and Microsoft Store refund direction, never a rule-based plan dressed as the AI plan.

demonstration.input_fixture: a completed run (next-repair) or a both-authors-declined event carrying token+machineId (make-good)
expected_outputs: completion -> a single-use 50% next-repair code (or an honest no-op if Stripe keys absent: ok, couponCode null)
AI unavailable -> a single-use 100% make-good code tagged email+machine, emailed, Support notified
no coupon path ever blocks, gates, or pressures the run

evidence.source: Placed from pronto-server-cloudrun.mjs (NEXTREPAIR50 next-repair coupon + the 100% AI-unavailable make-good stack, TOTEM-0013). Retired by TOTEM-X-0118 after StoreApp removed backend coupon/refund calls and the former backend source moved to archive/cloudrun-backend.
